exposure: Contextual modification and adaptation of Robson classification into existing workflow
outcome: CS rate in women with one previous CS
cohort: The study participants were women delivering in a public healthcare facility in North India.
finding: The quality improvement initiative led to temporary reductions in the overall caesarean section rate, which were not sustained, highlighting the complexity and multidimensional barriers to sustaining reductions.
mod_finding: A sustained reduction in the caesarean section rate was observed in women with one previous CS, decreasing from a mean of 94% to 86%.
followup_time: Ongoing, with observations reported from January 2019 to at least October 2021 (approximately 2 years and 10 months).
